sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Something pale stands between trees for less than a breath: deer, wolf, mist, branches, and too many eyes reflecting light that is not there.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Faint Divinity covered in eyes that cares for injured animals

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A half-seen deer-wolf apparition made of moonlit mist, thin branches, too many reflective eyes, and firefly motes that make mercy feel older than fear.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as an inference hook for old mercy in the forest. It should raise questions, not answer cosmology.
